Tomato Basil Soup

Posted by an invented cook · Serves 4

Ingredients:
1 kg ripe tomatoes, chopped
1 onion, diced
2 tbsp butter
500 ml vegetable stock
a handful of fresh basil
salt and pepper to taste

Method:
Melt the butter and soften the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and the stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the basil, blend until smooth and season.
